verdict.rationale: Homebrew collects usage data, so a training-data privacy question is a fair one to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions AI model training or any opt-out from it. The only related control is the option to turn off anonymous aggregate analytics, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
